notes.title: Changes! No more Nightmare Girls...
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
Some changes are coming to JNZ: Nightmare Girls.

This page will be closed soon…
But don’t worry — the project is still alive and kicking on Steam, just under a new name and with a new publisher!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3558200/JNZ_Anchor_Archetype/
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288796/92010f24fa4056d029989540260c00541be11558.jpg

So, what happened?


 The game is now an NSFW title, with proper age ratings and content tags. We wouldn't want to confuse anyone who is already subscribed about the content - so - the new page. (Don’t worry — the SFW mode is still available in the settings, for streamers and story lovers alike.)
 We’ve partnered with a publisher — TinyHat Studios! They'll be helping more people discover and share our love with JNZ.


If you added Nightmare Girls to your wishlist before - first of all, thank you so much for your early support!
We’d be incredibly grateful if you could now wishlist the new version as well. It really helps us a lot, especially during this transition.

If the new direction isn't quite what you were hoping for - we completely understand. We’re so thankful to have had you with us this far, and we hope our paths cross again in the future. 💜

This Nightmare Girls page will be disabled and removed soon.

Let’s keep dreaming together!
